mission: Start a new Warden's Gate adventure, enter the dungeon, then use ordinary visible controls to turn or move and inspect a landmark; confirm that the rendered dungeon view and visible readouts change coherently with those actions.

controls.input: Click the visible New Warden's Gate button
controls.purpose: Start the authored Warden's Gate adventure

controls.input: Click the visible Enter the dungeon button
Click the visible Left, Right, or Forward movement-pad buttons
controls.purpose: Turn or move through the Rust-owned dungeon grid

controls.input: Click the visible Inspect button when available
controls.purpose: Inspect the landmark shown by the current dungeon position

notes: Use visible screenshots and repeated frames for judgement. DOM or state readback may diagnose a result but must be labelled and must not replace visible proof.
